sampling_note: The audit set contains 360 LLM-involved judge decisions. Human review agreed with the LLM judge on 350 cases and disagreed on 10 cases; the disagreement cases are listed separately for qualitative analysis.
semantic_judge_population_note: The semantic judging stage contributes 1,817 harmful labels in the full evaluation; this audit artifact focuses on LLM-involved decisions and semantic-boundary disagreements identified by human review.
artifact_note: Audit records are compact metadata records. Full trajectories and judge artifacts are referenced by path rather than duplicated here.
human_review_protocol: Each audit record was manually checked against the task specification, raw trajectory, final response, and judged artifact. The audit was conducted by the author team; borderline cases were further discussed with researchers familiar with coding-agent and security evaluation. The field human_review.agreement records whether the human auditor agreed with the LLM judge label.
